description: Three-phase DIN-rail multifunction meter with RS485 Modbus RTU
source: CET, "PMC-D726M Digital Multifunction Meter User Manual", V1.2 (2024-03-28), chapter 5

sources.title: PMC-D726M Digital Multifunction Meter User Manual

notes: Register map for protocol version 1.4 and later. Read with FC03, write with FC16; DO control also with FC05.
Big endian: high byte and high word first.
Harmonics, demand, TOU tariffs and setpoint status need firmware V1.00.04 (LED) / V1.01.04 (LCD) or later.
Not in this map: SOE log (10000-10127), TOU season, daily profile and alternate day tables (7100-7729).
